verdict.detail: The album first came out in 1966 (US).

notes.text:
One of the earliest double album packages in the history of rock music [competing with 'Blonde On Blonde'], first released in USA July 1966.
This is the first UK double-album issue of the original recording (Stereo only) December 1971.
Labels have "TWO RECORD SET-RECORD No.#" in 2 lines on left side of label / MADE UNDER LICENCE... 
Records sided 1/2-1/2
Labels: MCPS. Frank Zappa Music: 2 lines 
Gatefold un-laminated cover: Verve logo to front & back.
2683 004 SELECT on back top-right & "Marketed by Polydor" bottom left. See images.
Vinyl (black/silver labels) packaged in punched poly-lined paper bags; 2352 023 & 2352 024 respectively. 

Black & white half-tone inner spread with "Biographical Trivia", notes on compositions and a list of influential musicians & celebrities under the heading: "These people have contributed materially in many ways to make our music what it is. Please do not hold it against them".
(Extensive content of these printed album notes can be found in 'images').

Track D1: Sleeve says "...Child-Killer", label is plural "...Child-Killers"

Made in Gt. Britain
